verdict.rationale: Unit documents that both its Dashboard and its APIs give teams access to customer, account, payment, card, transaction, compliance, and operational data, and that companies can build directly on the platform via APIs. That points to substantial API coverage of what the UI offers, but nothing in the evidence explicitly claims full UI/API parity, and probes found no public OpenAPI spec to verify coverage. missing for 10: explicit statement of complete Dashboard-to-API parity, a published API reference or OpenAPI spec showing endpoint coverage of dashboard operations, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Unit Dashboard and APIs provide teams with access to customer, account, payment, card, transaction, compliance, and operational data.
Companies can build directly on the Unit Platform using APIs and components, with control over their product experience and operating model.
Both approaches run on the same core infrastructure, allowing companies to deepen their integration over time without moving to a different platform.
